sources.basis: Original Go interpretation of container/volume superblocks, object maps, filesystem B-tree records, inodes, streams, attributes and Fletcher 64. Native qualification is separate. Keylocker, ONEKEY and extent crypto_id interpretation follow the encryption chapter; native evidence qualifies outer XTS keybags and current extent flag 1 where published details are incomplete. Snapshot metadata/name records, physical snapshot superblocks and transaction-bounded historical resolution are original interpretations of the snapshot and object-map chapters.

Original Go interpretation of volume headers, catalog and fork structures, B-tree traversal and native timestamps. Modern attributes and Finder behavior additionally reference the pinned Apple HFS source.
UDIF/GPT/APM layouts studied from v2 production code; independently implemented bounded full-disk reader. No test code imported.

Adapted hfs_zero_hidden_fields and the FinderInfo portion of hfs_vnop_getxattr. Go byte slices replace kernel cnode and vnode structures; public attribute results preserve native masking. Other reader structures are original Go interpretations of published layouts. Regular-file indirection follows cat_lookup/cat_resolvelink, including creation-date qualification and native inode identity. HFS+ comparison data translates gLatinCaseFold/gLowerCaseTable; the generator records the frozen UTF-16 comparison rules.
sources.licenseBasis: The translated file header specifies APSL 2.0. The upstream root APPLE_LICENSE contains the older APSL 1.2 and is inventoried for provenance, not used as the license text for this translation.

sources.basis: Port applicable preservation algorithms, not kernel dispatch wrappers. No code ported yet.

Decoder-only translation adapted from the inventoried v2 production port and reviewed against Apple C. Encoders, allocating convenience APIs and encoder tables were removed. Caller-owned bounded destinations, checked byte slices and explicit errors replace C pointers. Complete LZFSE blocks must match their declared decoded size. Native public-codec and filesystem observations qualify the admitted decmpfs profiles.

Native symlink attributes include a final NUL which readlink/st_size exclude. Large ordinary attributes use storage flags 0x11 and the published stream layout; the extra bit has undocumented write semantics. Reading this specific encoding is compared byte-for-byte with native getxattr. This does not authorize ignoring other unknown bits or claim write compatibility.

Generation compiles the pinned normalizeOptCaseFoldU32Char and its local helpers and materializes the Unicode 16 mappings plus original combining classes in pure Go. ASCII folding and Hangul are algorithmic. HFS+ uses the separately frozen Unicode 3.2 decomposition/class data in vfs_utfconvdata.h. The checked inputs do not use the build host's Unicode library. Admission of unassigned/invalid native names and historical APFS profiles are outside current qualification. Native APFS observations independently qualify the selected comparison behavior; the APFS reference alone does not specify this modern profile.
sources.licenseBasis: Apple table and HFS source headers specify APSL 2.0. The Unicode scalar normalizer additionally acknowledges Unicode and IBM/ICU; those copyright notices and their permission texts are retained in generated source and LICENSES.

sources.basis: Independent native lstat lookups include Unicode 11/14/16 case pairs, hard-link aliases share st_ino/st_nlink and all forks/metadata, and F_LOG2PHYS_EXT proves more than eight physical extents per fragmented HFS+ data/resource fork. Full hashes and native boundary samples qualify portable reads. Native evidence for other required macOS producers is generated and replayed in CI.

Decoder-only translation adapted from the inventoried v2 production port. Reviewed against Corellium libzbitmap C; this is not Apple-published source. Output is caller-owned and bounded before each chunk. Apple public-codec output and native filesystem reads provide independent qualification.

Only production decoder algorithms were retained, with upstream notices; no tests, encoders, decmpfs Handle or legacy filesystem orchestration imported. LZ4 framing is a v2 original MIT implementation, not an Apple C port; v3 requires complete bounded frames. Each codec is independently requalified from fresh native observations.

Original bounded reader using the documented decmpfs_disk_header layout, maximum attribute size and UF_COMPRESSED admission behavior. Codec storage framing was studied from v2 production and independently installed/read on native volumes. XNU dispatch and kernel cnode implementation are not copied.

Native ditto supplies LZVN filesystem storage. Apple public compression codecs supply other encoded payloads; final read-only kernel reads and public-codec decoding of stored bytes are independently compared. Types 1,3,4,7-16, stored markers, zlib optional checksum and resource descriptor gaps are exercised. Only 0xff is admitted as an LZFSE stored marker: a native malformed zero-marker file reports logical size but returns premature EOF; Go rejects it rather than synthesizing contents. macOS 15/26 may reject LZ4 types 15/16 at the filesystem layer even when their public codec decodes the stored bytes; CI records both outcomes explicitly.

GPL source studied for format facts: UUID-derived XTS outer bags, HMAC cookie, KEK/VEK DER layout and extent tweaks. No code copied or translated. Original bounded Go parsing and standard cryptographic constructions are independently checked against native Apple-created images. Legacy flag-2 key records remain explicitly unsupported.

Keybag entry alignment and key-record field study. DER lengths are big-endian. Structural and HMAC validation precede bounded password derivation; undocumented profiles do not fall through to authentication failure.

Header/API study only; no CommonCrypto C implementation copied or linked into Go. Native CCCryptor XTS, CCKeyDerivationPBKDF and CCSymmetricKeyWrap/Unwrap supply independent public vectors. AES-256-XTS vectors do not qualify a native APFS volume cipher profile.
Original bounded RFC 3394 unwrap with mandatory constant-time IV integrity verification, built on Go standard AES.

Original bounded multi-block PBKDF2 implementation with cancellation. APFS uses HMAC-SHA256 and encrypted DMG password records use HMAC-SHA1. Native CommonCrypto vectors and Apple-created images independently qualify the derived keys.

Production-only lessons; no test/harness material imported. v3 separates failed credentials, damaged key records and unsupported profiles, bounds aggregate derivation, validates HMAC and RFC3394 integrity, and uses per-extent tweaks. No v2 orchestration or cryptographic code copied.

Four Apple-created software-encrypted APFS volumes, 108 objects each, ordinary/Unicode/long/changed passwords and native rejection controls. Fresh read-only mounts with ownership enabled provide file and metadata hashes, including compressed files and modified clones. Native key records use flags 0, 40-byte wrapped keys, keybag version 2 and extent flag 1. Primitive reference bytes are independently generated with CommonCrypto. Broader key profiles require additional native evidence.
Published CSSM constants identify AES, 3DES, SHA1HMAC, PKCS5_PBKDF2, CBC_IV8, CBCPadIV8 and PKCS7 in native encrypted-image headers. Format identifiers studied; no Apple implementation copied.

Version 2 header, key-table and password-record layouts, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA1, key-cookie and per-block IV derivation studied. Original bounded Go interpretation; no Python code copied or translated. Native macOS evidence independently qualifies AES wrapping and both payload key sizes.
Older encrypted-image layout and 3DES password-wrapping facts cross-checked against vfdecrypt. No C implementation copied or translated; fixed-offset and AES-128-only assumptions are not inherited.

Six Apple-created AES-128/256 encrcdsa v2 images cover APFS, case-sensitive APFS, HFS+, HFSX, UDZO and raw UDRW, Unicode/changed/rejected passwords and an independently encrypted APFS volume. Each has 107 observed objects from a final read-only mount. Current native password records wrap with AES-192-CBC, declare an 8-byte IV and use a zero-extended 16-byte AES IV. Retained capture and file/source hashes are immutable; older wrapping profiles require their own native CI evidence.

Public snapshot enumeration and attribute ABI studied for an original Python ctypes collector. Kernel entitlement checks explain direct-call rejection; no kernel implementation copied. Apple asr and mount_apfs perform native snapshot creation and retention on disposable volumes.

Apple-created replication snapshots, UUID/XID inventory, native timestamps and final read-only historical mounts independently qualify two historical states alongside live state in ordinary, case-sensitive and nested encrypted APFS. The first saved superblock has no extended metadata OID; the live OID resolves the snapshot UUID at its XID. Unicode snapshot names and non-leaf snapshot metadata trees remain unqualified.
